spotlight.title: Congratulations to our Newly-certified Full Stack Developers!

persons.bio: Ardione David is a certified full stack developer who possesses a comprehensive skill set to build and maintain full-stack web applications, ensuring seamless integration between the front-end and back-end components while effectively managing data storage and retrieval, and application security. He's proficient in front-end using ReactJS with Vite, while NestJS for backend, with the use of Postgres and SQLite for database.
